canonical_statement: Global structures emerge from the compatibility of local information across different scales, rather than being pre-existent.

attributions.surface_quote: the global object should not be postulated first. Instead, it should emerge from compatibility across scales.

canonical_statement: A comprehensive relational object is only knowable through consistent sets of partial descriptions.

attributions.surface_quote: a global relational object is accessible only through coherent families of partial descriptions.

canonical_statement: Randomness is not an inherent property of an absolute state, but rather a characteristic of relational observations made through finite, compatible resolutions.

attributions.surface_quote: what is random is not an absolute state given once and for all, but a family of relational labels observed through compatible finite resolutions.

canonical_statement: Global reality is not a primitive entity but is indirectly reconstructed from compatible local relational data.

attributions.surface_quote: The primitive notion is rather that of compatible local relational data. The global object is reconstructed only indirectly.

canonical_statement: The fundamental nature of existence is relational, not based on absolute, independently existing observables.

attributions.surface_quote: one begins with local comparisons rather than absolute observables, and in which global structure appears only as the projective coherence of relational data across scales.

canonical_statement: Coherence in a system implies that its matrix can be generated by group-valued potentials.

attributions.surface_quote: coherence means that the matrix A is generated by a system of group-valued “potentials”

canonical_statement: Triangular defects represent fundamental obstacles to the existence of a potential representation.

attributions.surface_quote: triangular defects κijk are the basic obstructions to the existence of such a potential representation

canonical_statement: Inconsistency can be interpreted as a discrete curvature-type phenomenon.

attributions.surface_quote: inconsistency as a discrete curvature-type phenomenon

canonical_statement: Reality can be understood as a universal space of comparative fields compatible with all scales of discretization.

attributions.surface_quote: The projective limit X∞ may then be viewed as the universal space of all comparative fields compatible with all scales of the chosen discretization.

canonical_statement: Local multiplicative coherence in comparative data is indicated by the vanishing of inconsistency observables.

attributions.surface_quote: The inconsistency observables... vanish precisely when the comparative data satisfy local multiplicative coherence.

canonical_statement: The fundamental structure of reality is based on oriented decomposition and ordered gluing, not necessarily smooth manifolds or bundles.

attributions.surface_quote: What matters is only the syntax of oriented decomposition and ordered gluing.

canonical_statement: The underlying mathematical structure of reality can be interpreted through various semantic regimes (deterministic, probabilistic, causal) without altering its fundamental nature.

attributions.surface_quote: the same refinement syntax can be interpreted deterministically, probabilistically, or causally, without changing the underlying mathematical object.

canonical_statement: Observations across different scales of reality are consistent, meaning coarser configurations are marginals of finer-scale configurations.

attributions.surface_quote: The compatibility condition expresses the consistency of observations across scales: the random coarse configuration seen at level r is exactly the marginal of the finer-scale random configuration seen at level s.

canonical_statement: Local comparative information is coherently organized across all discretizations within a stochastic semantics.

attributions.surface_quote: a stochastic semantics in which local comparative information is organized coherently across all discretizations.

canonical_statement: A multi-scale dependency structure exists where finer elements direct coarser elements, implying a natural causal reading.

attributions.surface_quote: the refinement relation can be read as a directed dependence from finer pieces to coarser pieces.

canonical_statement: The fundamental framework of reality is transversal across geometry, semantics, and scale, unifying local data and global compatibility.

attributions.surface_quote: it is transversal with respect to geometry... semantics... scale: the finite-level configuration spaces... organize local data and global compatibility within one unified structure.

canonical_statement: The underlying structure of reality can be interpreted through various semantic frameworks, including classical, probabilistic, causal, quantum, or generalized probabilistic settings.

attributions.surface_quote: The refinement syntax itself is independent of this particular choice. This suggests the possibility of interpreting the same projective structure in broader probabilistic or causal frameworks, and perhaps eventually in quantum or generalized probabilistic settings.

canonical_statement: The process of constructing multi-scale objects from local comparative data is not restricted to a single semantic interpretation.

attributions.surface_quote: the passage from local comparative data to compatible multi-scale objects is not tied to one unique semantic regime.

canonical_statement: Global reality can be reconstructed from local relational data through compatibility constraints, rather than being derived from absolute observables.

attributions.surface_quote: one may begin with local relational data, impose compatibility... and reconstruct a global object only projectively.

canonical_statement: The fundamental nature of reality is relational and multi-scale, not composed of globally defined states.

attributions.surface_quote: closer in spirit to a relational and multi-scale ontology than to a theory of globally given states.

canonical_statement: Inconsistencies in relational structures represent obstructions to global coherence, analogous to curvature in geometric systems.

attributions.surface_quote: inconsistency observables... measure obstructions to global coherence. This gives them an interpretation akin to curvature-type quantities.

canonical_statement: Diverse systems involving local relational information share a common underlying mathematical structure.

attributions.surface_quote: apparently different situations may share a common mathematical substrate.
